trade.queued: Order received. It will fill shortly at the price at that time.

error.invalid-quantity: Quantity must be a whole number of 1 or more.
error.not-tradable: Trading is not available right now.

settlement.title: {era} Results
settlement.liquidated: All holdings were automatically sold at the current price.
settlement.formula: Returns are time-weighted. Money added mid-era (deposits) is not counted as profit; the era is split at each deposit and the segment returns are multiplied.
settlement.versionChange: The game was updated, so this era was settled at the prices from your last save. The new version applies from the next era.

report.title: Market Report
report.firstNotice: Market Report figures are what actually moved inside the game. They are not real market data or investment advice.
report.tentativeNote: This was a tentative report, so the effect was small. The outcome report may change things a lot.

tutorial.title: New here?
tutorial.notice1: News arrives without warning. Within an era, news items have no time order or connection, and even major historical events may not appear in this round.
tutorial.notice2: Only a 'tentative report' and its 'outcome report' about the same event are connected.
tutorial.notice3: Most of a news story's effect hits the price the moment it is announced, and the rest a few seconds later, so studying ahead works better than buying after you read it.
tutorial.notice4: The reaction rates on screen are fictional in-game numbers. They are not the real market or investment advice.
tutorial.stepWaiting: News is coming soon. Please wait a moment.
tutorial.stepReading: News is out! Time stops during the tutorial. Try buying a related stock.
tutorial.stepReaction: Most of the move hits the price the moment the news appears, and the rest 5 seconds later. Then prices keep swinging for 10 more seconds.
tutorial.stepReport: Two minutes later a Market Report appears right under the news. Check which stocks moved and why.
tutorial.done: Tutorial complete! In the main game, time keeps running when news breaks.

disclaimer.fictional: This is a fictional scenario based on real events and is not investment advice.

debrief.title: {era} Review
debrief.followed: It went the way the clue pointed

telemetry.consentBody: We'd like to collect play data (trades, screen time, etc.) to improve game balance. We never collect your name, contact info, or device IDs. You can play the same way without agreeing.

era.graceNotice: No news for the first 7 minutes. Look around the stocks and get ready.

work.payoutNote: Work income is paid all at once when the era ends.

music.tapToStart: Tap the screen once to turn on sound.
